company_name: Continental Airlines, Inc. / United Continental Holdings, Inc.

fuel_consumption.source_quote: Impact of $1 increase in price per barrel of fuel on annual fuel expense (based on 2011 projected fuel consumption): Continental segment $42 million (implies ~1,764 million projected gallons for 2011). UAL consolidated: $99 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: Continental segment at Dec 31, 2010: WTI crude oil swaps 14% (at $1.97/gal); WTI crude oil call options 10% (at $2.24/gal); WTI crude oil collars 4% (call $2.29/gal, put $1.57/gal). Total maximum price hedge: 28%, minimum price hedge 18%. Fair value asset $98 million. Continental merged with UAL Corporation on Oct 1, 2010; this is the first combined UAL/United/Continental 10-K filing under CIK 319687. UAL total hedge: 35% with fair value $375 million.

warnings: Continental Airlines merged with UAL Corporation on October 1, 2010, forming United Continental Holdings (UCH). This FY2010 10-K is the first combined filing. Continental continued as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Hedge data represents the Continental subsidiary segment.
